falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 cash index closes more than 4.0% above or below its close on the day of this verdict within the next 14 calendar days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive directional move resolves the UNKNOWN phase into a clear up or down regime and makes HOLD the wrong signal

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern-match similarity to bottom_2024_aug falls below 40% on the engine's own score within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom analog that frames this read is broken, so an UNKNOWN verdict resting on that resemblance is invalidated

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70, or at or below 15, on any daily reading in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A mid-range blowoff score of 39 no longer describes the tape; the regime is either a climax or clearly not one, so the indeterminate HOLD call is wrong

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
